notes.title: How Was Your Day? Made in New Zealand Feature
notes.content:
[p]Kia ora from Aotearoa (New Zealand)!  

Join us as we celebrate NZ made games and take another look at our demo playthrough - featuring all those sweet 80s vibes, improved tutorials, enhanced mini-games and more!     

We're working on more improvements on the demo and have decided to include voice in the game (!!) - we can't wait to share the updated version later this year and give you all the full Kiwi flavour.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, check out what makes this game quintessentially Kiwi - the characters, the scenery, the pies (!!) and just the overall vibes. Lakeview does seem idyllic from the outset but what secrets does it hold? 
[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199259464031"]https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199259464031[/url]
[/p][p]The Team at Mad Carnival 🎉[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: How Was Your Day? Demo Playthrough Stream

notes.title: How Was Your Day? Enhanced Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Kia ora Beans fans! [/p][p][/p][p]We've made some updates to offer a more enhanced demo

🎵 Background music and choice 80s tracks added 
📚 Additional tutorials for clearer gameplay
✨ General gameplay improvements and polish with a new puzzle added 
🎮 More logical mini-games with one unlock to help perfect your dog-finding skills
[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who played and shared feedback - it's made a real difference! Ready to dive back into Diya's mysterious world? Let us know what you think of the improvements.[/p][p]
The Team at Mad Carnival 🎉[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288845/3504ef41f2ba2a3fcda3f0c3c144c7c362c2623b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: How Was Your Day? Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi dog lovers and 80s fans!

Our demo has launched! If you love point and click mystery adventures with a touch of supernatural you'll love this game. 

Meet Diya and Beans and play some choice mini games inspired by the 80s. 

Have a play and please let us know what you think! 

Enjoy!
The Team at Mad Carnival 🎉

notes.title: How Was Your Day? Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi dog lovers and 80s fans!

Kia ora from Aotearoa, New Zealand! We can't wait to share our demo with you! In just under a week you'll get a chance to meet Diya, Beans and some of the other characters in Lakeview. 

In this 30-40 minute demo (maybe longer?) you'll get a taste of what's to come with our spooky narrative adventure. Experience Diya's frustrating day, talk to the residents, play mini games and pat Beans!

We'd love for you to have a play and let us know what you think! 

Thanks! 
The Team at Mad Carnival 🎉
